text:
Kara (docs): hey team — quick snag while updating the rate-limits/tiers pages. the dashboard PNGs in the doc still show the old slab label `Slab (floored)` and our curl/js snippets don't include the new X-Redwood-Account header. opened a tiny PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4761
Zane (backend): thanks Kara. backend ships a UI-only formatting change last week: slab numbers are rounded for display. no change to stored quota math or billing. panel id also changed to `usage_metering_v2` so examples that reference the raw query need updating.
Vera (analytics): confirmed. legacy integrations sometimes return `tier_key: "legacy"`. current doc example maps tiers directly which can confuse older customers. recommend a one-line mapping example and a short migration note.
Kara (docs): plan: (1) swap out images to the new exports, (2) update curl/js/py snippets to include `X-Redwood-Account`, (3) add a "what changed" callout and short FAQ line: "Why do my numbers look different?" -> explain visual-only rounding, (4) show mapping for `tier_key: legacy`.
Leo (product): add a single sentence in the PR description for support: "Visual-only display change; billing and quota computation unchanged." That reduces support noise.
l10n-bot: queued: will translate `docs/usage/metering.md` and `docs/pricing/tiers.md` after merge (en -> fr, de, ja). ETA 48h.
Zane (backend): I'll export images and push to branch `docs/4761-metering-fixes`. export command: `./infra/tools/export-dashboard --id usage_metering_v2 --out=docs/static/images/metering` note: our export tool adds PNG metadata; I'll strip metadata before committing.
Vera (analytics): snippet suggestion for mapping (JS):
```js
// map legacy tier_key for UI
const uiTier = resp.tier_key === 'legacy' ? 'free' : resp.tier_key;
```
Kara (docs): adding that. also updating the JS snippet to include the account header. old JS snippet: ```js
await client.get('/usage', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}` } })``` new snippet: ```js
await client.get('/usage', { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${TOKEN}`, 'X-Redwood-Account': 'acct_123' } })
// map legacy tier: const uiTier = resp.tier_key === 'legacy' ? 'free' : resp.tier_key;
```
Zane (backend): pushed images and updated the sample Grafana query in the branch. CI flagged an image lint due to metadata — stripped and re-pushed; should be green.
Leo (product): can we also add a one-line note in the pricing calculator page clarifying that slab boundaries are unchanged and only display rounding changed? that avoids confusion when customers compare numbers.
Kara (docs): will add that in the calculator explanation and include a tiny FAQ blurb. action items: Kara update PR (snippets, images, FAQ), Zane confirm export command in PR, Vera confirm wording for legacy mapping, Leo add product sentence in PR description. I'll request reviews once pushed. :thumbsup:
